content.short: Decimal provides blockchain infrastructure to create DApps for developers: Tools & Services.
content.description: Decimal is a multichain blockchain platform that empowers developers to create liquid tokens, NFTs, and scalable crypto applications. Built by developers around the world, applications, contracts, and tokens deployed on Decimal are supported by BSC, EVM, and IBC infrastructure, enabling interaction across networks such as BSC, ETH, Cosmos, Thorchain, Osmosis, and Secret. These assets work with wallets including MetaMask, Keplr, and Trust Wallet, making integration straightforward for users and builders alike.
